## Forms · Create Termination Request → `n8n_createTerminationRequest(actor, data, options)`
Real `submitTerminationRequest` → `TERM_…` workflow (sheet *Terminations*) → HR approval email. Keys are the **raw HTML names**.
**Required** (r2, verified; = HTML-required controls): `reqName reqEmail empName empType(Hourly|Salary) siteName(reference.sites) termDate lastDayWorked(yyyy-MM-dd) reason(Deceased|End of contract|Resigned|Retired|Terminated) managerName managerEmail has_reports(Yes|No)`
**Conditional (UI rules, enforced here):** `hr_approved` when reason = Terminated; `reports_to_new` when has_reports = Yes; `google_*` when systems contains "Google Account".
**Optional:** `empWorkEmail systems[] equip[] google_forward google_files google_delegate google_duration google_vacation comments`; via `extra`: `empPhone attachmentBase64 attachmentName attachmentMimeType`.
`systems` ⊂ ADP Supervisor Access, BOSS, CAA, Delivery, Google Account, Incidents, Fleetio, Central Purchasing/Jonas · `equip` ⊂ Computer/Laptop, Mobile Phone, Tablet, Credit Card, Vehicle and Keys, Building Access Card/Keys — sent comma-joined.
Returns `{ workflowId, message }`. **Authorization ≠ attribution:** role checks run against the real Execution API session (`efx-bot@team-group.com`); `actor` is recorded for attribution only.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
